rules.rule: Prioritize authentication, authorization, secret exposure, command injection, path traversal, unsafe process execution, and fail-open security behavior. Report only actionable issues with a concrete exploit or failure path.

Prioritize authentication, authorization, secret exposure, command injection, path traversal, unsafe process execution, and fail-open security behavior. Report only actionable issues with a concrete exploit or failure path.
Check completion gates for bypasses, stale evidence reuse, fail-open error handling, race conditions, and paths that can mark work complete before required verification succeeds.
Check control-plane state transitions, authorization boundaries, idempotency, cancellation, and persistence for bypasses or inconsistent terminal states.
